top_signals.title: Monster Shares Fall as Weaker Margins Highlight Cost Burden
top_signals.summary: Monster Beverage Corp. shares fell as much as 8.2% Friday, the biggest decline in over two years, after the energy drink giant’s weaker-than-expected margins underscored the impact of soaring costs in the beverage industry.
